purpose: Test whether the one-dimensional effective-independence reduction that is exact/variance-sufficient in the bilinear theory survives structurally distinct nonlinear ecology and a second correlation implementation.
interpretation_change: The historical generic audit correctly establishes a crossover sufficient condition and a correlated variance floor, but its field_mapping that effective stochastic independence is the relevant scaling coordinate is too strong for nonlinear systems. In Lane B v2, k_eff is treated only as a variance-equivalent coordinate unless sufficiency is separately demonstrated.
analytic_targets: Derive exact bilinear I/C invariance and the prohibition on C-versus-I order reversal.
State the smooth first-order result as asymptotic/leading-order I/C stabilization, not exact finite-k invariance.
Use strong I/C drift or C/I reversal as a nonlinear-departure diagnostic.

nonlinear_generalization.role: structurally distinct exploratory response class, not a second pollination parameterization
nonlinear_generalization.admission_rule: Report the entire 54-setting grid. Do not promote only settings that show an intermediate interaction-dominated phase.

correlation_robustness.role: robustness check against whole-community clone mixing
correlation_robustness.identity_rule: Pollinator identities and trait draws remain independent across copies; only arrival/loss event shocks share Gaussian common components.
correlation_robustness.k_eff_calibration: Compute realized pairwise correlation of final pollinator counts across copies and convert that correlation to a variance-equivalent k_eff. This k_eff is not asserted to be a sufficient statistic.

claim_boundaries: The consumer-resource grid is exploratory because Lane B was reframed after inspecting the original pollination model.
The correlation robustness analysis tests implementation dependence, not a natural synchrony estimate.
A failure of k_eff sufficiency is a model-class statement only after it is reproduced across structurally different nonlinear systems.
I/C is an exact invariant only in the bilinear model; do not preregister rho-invariance of I/C in Lane C from the current nonlinear evidence.
